feedTitle: Weather forecast for the Isle of Man

items.title: Weather forecast updated as of 14 May 2026 8:02pm
items.description:
##Weather##

Issued on Thursday, 14 May 2026 at 8:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Detailed forecast##

Showers at first will move away through the first part of tonight, with clear spells thereafter as the fresh to strong northwest winds ease a little. Minimum temperature tonight 5°C.

Tomorrow will then be a fine and sunny day, and less breezy than recent days with moderate or fresh northwest winds. Maximum temperature 12°C.


##Outlook##

A dry start on Saturday, but rain and drizzle arriving for the afternoon and evening.

Then dry at first on Sunday before rain arrives from the west as the day goes on.


##Sunrise##

5:15am Tomorrow


##Sunset##

9:14pm Tomorrow
